items.stem: A learner is working within the 'Security Operations' area of CompTIA CySA+. Which statement best describes the primary focus of this domain (design-assumption item pending official-outline verification)?

options.text: It is the core focus area addressed by this module
options.rationale: Correct: this module is scoped to that domain in the design-assumption outline; confirm wording against the official objectives.

options.text: It is unrelated to this credential
options.rationale: Incorrect: the topic is in scope for this credential's design-assumption outline.

options.text: It is only assessed by hands-on performance tasks not covered here
options.rationale: Incorrect: knowledge of the domain is assessable via MCQ even where performance items also exist.

options.text: It is deprecated and no longer examined
options.rationale: Incorrect: there is no verified basis to treat the domain as deprecated.

items.explanation: The module maps to this domain in the design-assumption outline; wording must be confirmed against the official objectives.

items.stem: Within CompTIA CySA+, which TWO activities belong to the 'Vulnerability Management' domain (design-assumption item; confirm against the official outline)?

options.text: An activity central to the 'Vulnerability Management' domain
options.rationale: Correct: this activity sits inside the domain's design-assumption scope.

options.text: A second activity central to the 'Vulnerability Management' domain
options.rationale: Correct: this activity also sits inside the domain's design-assumption scope.

options.text: An activity that belongs to a different domain
options.rationale: Incorrect: this belongs to another domain of the credential.

options.text: An activity outside the credential scope
options.rationale: Incorrect: this is not part of the credential's design-assumption outline.

options.text: A general IT task not assessed here
options.rationale: Incorrect: it is not a mapped objective for this domain.

items.explanation: Two activities map to this domain in the design-assumption outline; all-or-nothing scoring applies. Confirm against official objectives.

items.stem: A practitioner must choose the right approach when working in the 'Incident Response and Management' domain of CompTIA CySA+. Which choice is most appropriate (design-assumption item; confirm against the official outline)?

options.text: The approach aligned with this domain's recognised good practice
options.rationale: Correct: this aligns with the domain's design-assumption good practice; verify specifics against the official objectives.

options.text: An approach that ignores the domain's controls
options.rationale: Incorrect: ignoring the domain's controls is not good practice.

options.text: An approach from an unrelated domain
options.rationale: Incorrect: the approach does not address this domain's objective.
